content.full_text: Degree programmes I If you are applying for a degree programme in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Health, Energy & Environment, Law or Construction & Real Estate Management , please proceed as follows. List of degree programmes I At HTW Berlin, this applies to the following Master’s degree programmes: Angewandte Informatik Arbeits- und Personalmanagement Bauingenieurwesen Betriebliche Umweltinformatik Computer Engineering Construction and Real Estate Management Elektrotechnik Facility Management Fahrzeugtechnik Finance, Accounting, Corporate Law, Taxation Finanzmathematik, Aktuar- und Risikomanagement Gebäudeenergie- und -informationstechnik Industrial Sales and Innovation Management Informatik in Ingenieurwissenschaften Informations- und Kommunikationstechnik International Business Internationaler Studiengang Medieninformatik Life Science Engineering Maschinenbau Mikrosystemtechnik Regenerative Energien Unternehmenssteuerrecht Wirtschaftsinformatik Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen Wirtschaftskommunikation Wirtschaftsrecht You should apply via the HTW application portal if one of the following requirements applies to you: You obtained your first academic degree in Germany . You are a national of an EU or EEA country . ✗ HTW application portal (15.11. - 15.12.22) The following application periods apply: Winter semester: 16.05. - 15.06. Sommersemester: 15.11. - 15.12. or You should apply via uni-assist if you obtained your first academic degree outside Germany and are not a national of an EU or EEA country . ✗ uni-assist (01.10.22 - 15.12.23) The following application periods apply: Winter semester: 02.04. - 15.06.
